name: Mai
source:
A girl from Germany who transferred to the main character's class.
Her short silver hair and long limbs make her stand out.

Even though she struggles a bit with speaking Japanese, her composed attitude and kind nature makes her popular with the other students.

However, something about her smile starts to worry the protagonist.

[Translated from the [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160401085609/http://www.sakuramint.net/tsugiteras/tsugi_chara.htm]official website[/url]]
